app.search_expert_help: Expert mode: filter items with a JMESPath expression evaluated on raw field keys (case sensitive). e.g. [?contains(Title, 'FK') && RightsStatus=='All Done']
app.search_expert_help_intro: Expert mode evaluates a JMESPath expression directly on the items of the currently selected type. Unlike basic mode, the expression must use internal field names (e.g. Title, RightsStatus), not the translated labels shown in the UI (e.g. Title, Status).
app.search_expert_help_basics_raw_keys: Field names are raw keys: Type, Title, RightsStatus, Identifier, DateEarliest… (not the translated labels used in basic mode).
app.search_expert_help_basics_syntax: A filter expression is written between brackets: [?condition]. Combine conditions with && (and) and {'||'} (or).
app.search_expert_help_fields_hint: Internal field names to use in the expression, with their label shown in the UI for the currently loaded project.
app.search_expert_help_fields_none_loaded: Load a trench to see the list of available fields.
app.search_expert_help_example_date: Items whose earliest date is after January 1st, 2024.
app.search_expert_help_warning: An invalid expression shows an inline error and is not applied: the results shown stay those of the last valid expression.
